agent.problem: Stop 1, card 6 quotes "Grace and peace to you.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

agent.problem: Discovery questions dominate the stop instead of remaining the exception. Cards 2, 4, 6, 8, 13 and 17 ask for information the earlier cards have not provided enough context to reason out. For example, card 8 gives no basis for deciding why Paul thanks God, and card 17 offers three believable attributes of God with no way to choose among them except prior knowledge or luck.

rule.text: A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
